title: Phase 2 - Upper / lower / full (3 days)
source: Fallback for weeks with less time: 4 gym days, every muscle twice a week, 1-2 conditioning or soccer days.

progression: Build up to the top of the rep range on every set at or below the week's RPE, then add weight (about 5 lb upper body, 10 lb lower body). Miss the bottom of the range two sessions in a row: drop about 10%.
warmup: 8-10 min: easy bike or jog, dynamic mobility, then 1-2 warm-up sets at 60-75% of the first exercise's working weight

blocks.note: Assisted until you get 8 clean reps.
No gym needed. Add 1 round a week, up to 10. Soccer counts instead. No time or space? A 45-60 min brisk walk.

benchmarks.note: phone video timing, same surface each time
